Eclectic New Indie.calibration_requirements: Measure actual separately rendered stem active level and peak; confirm exact original source mapping, musical role, kick audibility and subjective mix; never interpret proposals as universal published dB standards.

musical_definition.scope_note: 2026 SoundCloud emerging new-indie scene profile; treated as a scene, not mature universal genre grammar.
musical_definition.groove_behavior: flexible indie/rock/folk/hip-hop-informed pulse; live-feeling or programmed groove may coexist
musical_definition.phrase_behavior: song-oriented phrases with vulnerable/intimate verses and dynamic chorus or textural shifts
musical_definition.harmony_behavior: simple indie harmony, alt-rock motion, R&B color or plugg-adjacent loop language may coexist by component map
musical_definition.bass_behavior: electric/acoustic bass or programmed sub depending track; avoid assuming one palette
musical_definition.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: live drum, drum-machine or hybrid behavior explicitly selected
musical_definition.instrument_role_behavior: guitar-led or guitar-less arrangements, vocals/lead, bass, live/programmed drums, digital textures
musical_definition.ensemble_player_behavior: DIY/raw character may coexist with precise programmed elements
musical_definition.arrangement_transformation: verse/chorus or short scene-driven structures; contrast between acoustic/raw and electronic layers
musical_definition.articulation_behavior: raw guitar/vocal-like articulation, lo-fi textures, programmed transients as selected
musical_definition.timing_humanization_behavior: human/live timing or programmed grid chosen by component, not averaged blindly
musical_definition.sound_effects_intent: chorus, distortion, saturation, digital artifacts and room tone may be deliberate
musical_definition.mix_prominence_intent: lead intimacy prioritized; production artifacts are supporting identity

Eclectic New Indie.musical_development_policy: Build this genre's melody, harmony, bass, percussion, rhythm, form and expressive behaviors from its own definition and original sample links; no shared melody copying, no source edits, no blended stems.
